recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-36127 source follow-up is needed; any future SearchParameter naming-policy work or `{1,254}` minimum-length review should proceed under separate Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-36127 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction, raised in R4B and applied for R5, reporting that many root-level cnl-0 constraints used `name.matches('[A-Z]([A-Za-z0-9_]){0,254}')`. Because `name` is optional, the unguarded expression evaluates to `{}` rather than `true` when `name` is absent. The requested correction was to avoid warning/failing resources with no `name`, either by moving the constraint to `name` or otherwise guarding the root expression.
initial_application: The Jira comment records R4B commit `cada1a356c` and R5 commit `9ea5ca6fcc`. Git history confirms both commits changed affected StructureDefinition expressions, including `source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml`, from bare `name.matches(...)` to `name.exists() implies name.matches(...)`.
additional_context: FHIR-34147 later deliberately changed the same machine-friendly-name regexes from `{0,254}` to `{1,254}`, and commit `5fbb239871` later anchored the expressions for QA. Zulip discussion shows the original optional-field report that led to FHIR-36127; a later `implies` thread briefly questioned this guarded form, but the concern was retracted after confirming `name.exists()` is false when `name` is absent. FHIR-41623 surfaced as an unresolved SearchParameter.name policy discussion but is Triaged and not a final decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope PlanDefinition source and other current StructureDefinition sources with this name regex already use the guarded `name.exists() implies ...` form, and source searches found no remaining root-level `<expression value="name.matches(` constraints in current `source/`.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that changed the same regex family from `{0,254}` to `{1,254}`, explaining the current regex while preserving the FHIR-36127 optional-name guard.
Triaged SearchParameter.name policy issue surfaced by cnl-0 searches; it is unresolved and not a final decision for this reconciliation.
